text:
Jules: Quick pitch  a tightly scoped PLG test: 20m "Launch Lab" webinar + 30 starter credits + 3 ready-to-run prompt templates. Hypothesis: combo increases 'first-session completions' by ~22%.
Ivy: Nice. Primary metric: % new signups who run >=1 successful generation within 24h AND time-to-first-success <= 10m. Secondary: gen_count_7d, retention_d7.
Marco: Cohorts: control | credits_only | webinar_only | combo. Need a control. Baseline ~10% -> aiming for ~12.2% absolute. Power estimate: ~1.6k per arm for 80% power.
Sam: Channels: product banner, blog post, dev Discord, paid tweet. Use utm_source params: ?utm_source=banner&utm_campaign=launchlab_v1&arm=combo. I'll sketch ad copy.
Jules: Prompt templates: "Two-line cold outreach", "Feature idea brainstorm (3 bullets)", "Data->insights paragraph". Keep token counts low.
Ivy: Landing CTA test: "Reserve lab + claim credits" vs "Try now  get starter credits". Also add 1-click "run sample" for logged-in users, otherwise show curl snippet.
Marco: Backend: create promo pool launchlab_pool (4000). Assign endpoint: POST /promo/assign {user_id,pool} -> {code,expires_at}. Single-use, expiry 14d. @AssignBot
AssignBot: Promo pool created: launchlab_pool (4000 codes). Endpoint available. Auth via service token.
Sam: Measurement schema: signup_source, promo_code, webinar_reg, first_gen_ts, gen_count_24h, ttfs, retention_d7. QA: validate with 2 staging accounts.
Jules: Owners: Sam = landing + social narrative; Ivy = templates + webinar script; Marco = metrics + infra coordination; AssignBot = promo pool. Drafts by Thu EOD.
Ivy: Can someone add a tiny micro-eval (5 gold prompts) to sanity-check template outputs across two models? Want >=80% acceptability.
Marco: Noted. We'll include micro-eval and a small benchmark slide (tokens/cost/latency). Avoid large claims.
Jules: Great. I'll write the experiment brief and post link here. Weekly sync next Wed 9am PT. :rocket:
